authorization.active_proposed_redesign: configured shared-credential authorization for normal and golden keys, with owner-bound compatibility records; not approved as source parity
authorization.administrative_override: universal_key; operator audit is not implemented

invariants: Client input never directly mutates lock state.
Player A cannot mutate Player B's configured key digest or inventory.
Players who independently configure the same credential can authorize the same shared-credential lock.
A lock in one dimension cannot authorize or block the same coordinates in another dimension.
Concurrent create/remove uses record revision checks and produces one authoritative result.
Disconnect and reconnect preserve authorization behavior without duplicating records.
Two players using different locks cannot affect each other's records.
unverified: simultaneous remove and open through event adapters
